shared_elements: animals rendered in profile (hieroglyphic signs in A, relief beasts in B)
row of repeated small figures along a band
justification: Both surfaces divide the field with horizontal lines into stacked registers and both contain small profile creatures (birds and quadrupeds) repeated along a band, plus a band of repeating geometric motifs — but these are generic organising devices found in many unrelated traditions. The depicted content is otherwise unrelated: A shows a human adoration scene with a radiating disc, offering table and dense rows of standardised sign-writing, while B shows only large low-relief animals (felines, quadrupeds, a snake/bird) with no human figures, no disc and no writing.
